points.description: The answer conveys that a variable is a location in computer memory (a storage location, not just a name or label for a value).
The answer conveys that this memory location can store a value.

rubric.notes: Full marks for explaining that a variable is a location in memory that holds a value, in any equivalent wording. Award P1 only if the student refers to memory or storage, and P2 only if the student says the location holds a value. A answer that only gives a definition without memory, such as "a name for data", earns no marks for P1 but may earn P2 if it still says a value is stored.
